title: Accidental Damage Coverage Terms for Northgate Optical Eyewear
content:
Accidental damage coverage at Northgate Optical belongs to the two premium lens designs. Under it, eyewear the patient damages by accident is replaced for a charge, within a set number of months after dispensing and a set number of times per job.

| Lens design | Coverage period (months after dispensing) | Accidental damage charge percentage | Replacements per job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 0 (no coverage) | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 0 (no coverage) | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 0 (no coverage) | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 0 (no coverage) | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 12 | 30 percent | 1 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 12 | 30 percent | 1 |

## What the figures mean

- A coverage period of 0 means the design carries no accidental damage coverage.
- On Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses and Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses, accidentally damaged eyewear is replaced within 12 months after dispensing, once per job, and the design's accidental damage charge percentage is 30 percent.

## Coverage questions

**Is accidental damage covered on Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses?** No. Its coverage period is 0 months.

**How many accidental damage replacements does a Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses job allow?** One.
